title: The Gaze of the Demonic Path Saint
next_chapter_hook: In the instant the two reached an agreement, the void at the entrance of the secret realm suddenly twisted, and a mysterious force obscured everyone's thread of fate—this scene made Chen Ji feel for the first time a fear beyond the Tianji Record.

text.content:
The cold wind at the secret realm's entrance carried a bloody scent, the three assassins' bodies still lying in pools of blood.

The disciples' discussions gradually quieted down, and all eyes fell upon that seemingly cowardly Servant Disciple with a mixture of reverence.

Yet Chen Ji knew the true test had only just begun.

His gaze swept across the crowd without leaving a trace, pausing for a moment in a shadowed corner—there, a line of sight was piercing through the crowd, falling directly upon him.

That gaze was ice-cold and sharp, yet carried an indescribably complex emotion.

dialogue.content:
「Interesting.」

A cold female voice sounded beside Chen Ji's ear, carrying a languid playfulness.

Ye Qing had somehow appeared three steps away, her dark red long skirt rustling in the wind. Her lips curved slightly upward, but her eyes held no笑意, only scrutiny and assessment.

「Chen Ji, a servant disciple of the Tianqing Sect, who has walked the martial world for over a decade under the name of 'waste,' yet counter-killed three of our Holy Sect assassins in their certain-kill strike.」

Her voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached everyone present.

「Are you still going to keep pretending?」

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart sank slightly.

The Demonic Path Saint stepping in personally meant his plans had been partially seen through. But what made him more alert was the implication in Ye Qing's words—she seemed to know more than he had anticipated.

The surrounding discussions abruptly ceased. Disciples from various sects looked at each other, clearly not expecting the Demonic Path Saint to appear personally, let alone point out a servant disciple.

Chen Xuan's residual soul rippled in the Mental Sea:

「Be careful. This woman carries the aura of the Tianji Record—faint, but definitely present. She may have touched a fragment, or... been chosen by one.」

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, yet his face remained that of a coward.

dialogue.content:
「Your Highness the Saint is joking.」

Chen Ji bowed respectfully, his voice carrying a hint of panic.

「This humble one is merely a servant, how would I know anything about pretending? Those assassins simply had inadequate skills—their deaths can only blame their bad luck. I just happened to have good luck...」

He raised his head, eyes full of flattery and fear, perfectly portraying the countenance of a villain using the prestige of others.

Yet Ye Qing's gaze grew deeper.

「Luck?」 She laughed lightly, 「Finding three weak points in the assassins' formation within three breaths, then striking a fatal blow—is this also luck?」

Her fingers lifted gently, spiritual light gathering at her fingertips.

「Chen Ji, do you think I'm one of those idiots?」

text.content:
Spiritual pressure pressed down like a mountain, forcing the surrounding disciples to retreat step by step.

Yet Chen Ji remained motionless.

His smile remained humble, but a sharp glint flickered in the depths of his eyes.

「Your Highness the Saint's eyes are as discerning as ever, this humble one is truly impressed.」

His voice remained humble, yet the meaning in his words shifted subtly.

「Since Your Highness wishes to know, then this humble one dares to ask—what do you want?」

A satisfied light finally flashed in Ye Qing's eyes.

「Now that's more like it.」 She withdrew her spiritual pressure, 「Do you remember the seven-day agreement?」

dialogue.content:
The seven-day agreement.

Three months ago, Chen Ji had foreseen a scene using the Tianji Record. He had seen Ye Qing being chased by Holy Sect experts, severely wounded, and he had intervened at a critical moment, exchanging it for a promise from the Demonic Path Holy Sect.

Yet now Ye Qing bringing it up herself made him smell something unusual.

「In three days, the secret realm opens.」 Ye Qing's voice was extremely low, audible only to Chen Ji, 「Within this secret realm lies an Ancient Forbidden Land. At its core rests a page of the Tianji Record Fragment.」

Chen Ji's heart lurched.

「I want you to retrieve it for me.」 Ye Qing's gaze fixed tightly on him, 「In exchange—I can tell you why the aura of the Tianji Record is on me.」

text.content:
Chen Ji's heartbeat abruptly accelerated.

The aura of the Tianji Record Fragment—this was precisely the answer he had always wanted to know. Though Mo Xiansheng was the guardian of the residual soul, regarding the history and distribution of the Tianji Record, he was always vague.

Yet Ye Qing, a Demonic Path Saint, was actually mentioning this voluntarily.

How much of this was real? How much was a trap?

Chen Xuan's residual soul pondered in the Mental Sea:

「The aura on her is real, but it doesn't come from the Tianji Record itself—it's more like... being marked by the Tianji Record. Be careful, this woman harbors great secrets.」

Chen Ji took a deep breath, yet his expression remained unmoved.

「Your Highness the Saint, your condition... is rather sudden.」

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's condition concealed profound mysteries, Chen Ji must choose between cooperation and danger.

choices.description: Prioritize intelligence gathering, reach a secret agreement with Ye Qing to enter the secret realm together.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain clues about the Tianji Record on Ye Qing
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's true intentions remain unclear

dialogue.content:
「Refreshing.」

A slight smile formed at the corner of Ye Qing's mouth, seemingly quite satisfied with Chen Ji's straightforwardness.

「Then our agreement is—in the secret realm, we share information. I cover your identity, you retrieve that fragment for me. After success, I tell you everything you wish to know.」

She extended her hand, a dark red contract mark materializing in her palm.

「Sworn with Demonic Path Holy Blood, do you dare accept?」

choices.text: Demand to Inspect the Goods First
choices.description: First have Ye Qing reveal part of the source of the Tianji Record aura, then decide whether to cooperate.
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may withdraw her sincerity

dialogue.content:
「Your Highness the Saint, please remain calm.」

Chen Ji smiled, his smile carrying a hint of cunning.

「Your Highness wants this humble one to take risks in the secret realm, I am naturally willing. But you must show some sincerity, let this humble one know whether this deal is worth the trouble.」

He lowered his voice, his gaze direct.

「Where does that aura on Your Highness come from? No need to tell everything, just one thing first—was it the Tianji Record that actively marked you, or did you actively come into contact with the Tianji Record?」

choices.description: Refuse cooperation with the Demonic Path, maintain innocence, avoid being drawn into a larger vortex.
choices.visible_cost: Lose clues to the Tianji Record Fragment
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may become an enemy

dialogue.content:
「No need.」

Chen Ji's voice abruptly cooled, that cowardly aura vanishing without a trace.

「This humble one may be a废物, but I still have some bottom line. Things of the Demonic Path, I don't wish to沾染.」

Ye Qing's gaze shifted slightly, seemingly not expecting him to refuse so bluntly.

「Are you certain?」 Her voice carried a dangerous undertone, 「This is the whereabouts of the Tianji Record Fragment, are you certain you wish to give it up?」

Chen Ji turned around, his back to her.

「Certain.」

text.content:
Ye Qing's gaze flickered uncertainly.

She was clearly reassessing this "废物" before her. After a moment, she laughed softly, putting away the contract mark in her palm.

「You are quite cautious.」 Her tone revealed neither joy nor anger, 「But caution is good, at least it shows you're not the kind of fool with a simple mind.」

She didn't immediately answer Chen Ji's question, but turned aside, gazing toward the distant secret realm entrance.

「Three years ago, I touched a broken stone tablet in an ancient ruin. The tablet bore symbols of the Tianji Record, and the aura on my body was acquired at that time.」

Her voice slightly lowered.

「Since then, I've been able to faintly sense the existence of other Tianji Record Fragments. The Holy Sect's pursuit of me is related to this.」

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji narrowed his eyes.

This intelligence was more valuable than he had anticipated.

The Tianji Record Fragments could actively mark those who touched them—what did this mean? Could the Tianji Record not be a mere technique, but a conscious existence?

「So, that fragment in the secret realm, you can sense its location?」

Ye Qing nodded: 「I know the location, but there's an ancient formation seal there—my cultivation can't break it. But you—」

Her gaze fell upon Chen Ji, carrying a hint of inquiry.

「You carry the aura of the Tianji Record. Perhaps you can pass through.」

Chen Ji was silent for a moment.

「Cooperation is possible. But I have an additional condition.」

choice.prompt: Cooperation conditions are on the table, Chen Ji needs to propose his own bargaining chips.

choices.description: Require Ye Qing to provide internal Holy Sect intelligence, including the true reason for their pursuit.
choices.risk_hint: Risk of exposing one's own intelligence

text.content:
「You only told half the story about why the Holy Sect pursues you.」

Chen Ji's voice was very light, but every word was crystal clear.

「I want the full version. What do they want to obtain from the Tianji Record Fragment? And why must they put you to death?」

Ye Qing's gaze flickered slightly, a meaningful smile appearing at the corner of her lips.

「You want to know what the Holy Sect wants?」 She paused, 「What they want, and what you want, may not be so different—」

「The method to become immortal.」

choices.description: Require Ye Qing to provide protection within the secret realm against threats from other sects.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the protection of the Demonic Path Saint
choices.risk_hint: May be seen as an accomplice by the Holy Sect

text.content:
「Within the secret realm, experts are as numerous as clouds.」

Chen Ji sighed, wearing a bitter expression.

「This humble one is merely a servant disciple—going in there might leave nothing but bones. Your Highness wants this humble one to handle business, surely you must provide some protection?」

Ye Qing laughed lightly, seemingly amused by his "brazen shamelessness."

「You want me to protect you?」 She eyed him with playful assessment, 「You certainly make good calculations.」

After contemplation, she nodded.

「Acceptable. But only within the secret realm—once outside, we're even.」

choices.description: Require that actions within the secret realm be commanded by him, with Ye Qing coordinating.
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may walk away in anger

dialogue.content:
「There's one more thing.」

Chen Ji's tone remained flat, yet the implication in his words caused Ye Qing's brow to furrow slightly.

「Within the secret realm, you follow my lead.」

The air seemed to freeze for a moment.

Ye Qing's gaze abruptly sharpened, the Demonic Path Saint's pressure almost ready to erupt. Yet Chen Ji remained nonchalant, as if completely unaware.

「You...」 Ye Qing's voice carried a dangerous undertone, 「Do you know what you're saying?」

「Of course I know.」 Chen Ji smiled, 「You want the fragment, I have this ability. You need me, so I am the one in command. This is fair, isn't it?」

text.content:
Ye Qing fell silent.

She stared at Chen Ji for a long while, as if trying to see through him. Those deep eyes flickered with complex light—surprise, scrutiny, and a barely discernible hint of... appreciation?

「You truly are no ordinary person.」

She finally spoke, her voice carrying a hint of emotion.

「Fine, I agree. Within the secret realm, you are in command.」

Chen Ji slightly nodded, a satisfied smile appearing on his face.

「Then, pleasant cooperation.」

The two smiled at each other, a subtle tacit understanding permeating the air. Yet Chen Ji knew this was merely surface peace.

Ye Qing still harbored too many secrets, and her understanding of him might also be greater than he had imagined.

A larger game of chess had just begun.

dialogue.content:
「By the way, there's one more thing.」

Ye Qing suddenly spoke, her tone becoming somewhat subtle.

「After entering the secret realm, you'd best stay far from the people of Tianqing Sect.」

Chen Ji's brow furrowed: 「Why?」

「That old fox Ling Yuan is more dangerous than you imagine.」 Ye Qing's voice was extremely low, 「He's searching for something, and that something is related to the Tianji Record.」

She didn't say more, merely giving Chen Ji a meaningful glance.

「We shall meet again in three days.」

With that, her figure dissolved into the shadows like smoke, leaving only a faint lingering fragrance.

text.content:
Chen Ji stood in place, gazing at the direction where Ye Qing had vanished, a solemn glint flickering in his eyes.

Ling Yuan—that old Sect Master who ostensibly sheltered him yet harbored hidden malice.

He had long known Ling Yuan was investigating the secrets of the Tianji Record—Chen Ji was well aware of this. But Ye Qing's warning indicated that Ling Yuan's movements were faster and deeper than anticipated.

「She's testing you.」 Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded in the Mental Sea, 「She may not know everything about the Ling Yuan matter. Saying these words, perhaps she wants you to stand with her against Ling Yuan.」

Chen Ji nodded lightly.

Of course he wouldn't readily believe Ye Qing's words. But one thing was certain—Ling Yuan was indeed a major threat he must resolve as soon as possible.

dialogue.content:
「Brother Chen Ji.」

A clear and cold voice came from behind.

Chen Ji turned around, seeing Su Qingyao standing not far away, her gaze complex as she looked at him. Her expression remained that cold facade, yet hidden deep in her eyes was an irrepressible hint of inquiry.

「That woman just now—was she the Demonic Path Saint Ye Qing?」

Her voice was very calm, yet Chen Ji heard a warning undertone within it.

「Sister Su.」 Chen Ji slightly bowed, his face resuming that honest and simple smile, 「That was just a misunderstanding—Her Highness the Saint must have mistaken someone.」

Su Qingyao stared at him, her gaze sharp as a sword.

「Is that so?」

Her tone carried obvious disbelief.

text.content:
The atmosphere slightly congealed.

Chen Ji knew Su Qingyao was the most perceptive of them all. She might not yet know he was the culprit, but had already faintly sensed his extraordinary nature.

Three times now.

This was the third time she had come infinitely close to the truth.

Chen Ji sighed silently in his heart, yet his expression remained unmoved.

「If Sister doesn't believe, you may ask the Sect Master.」 He laughed while trying to ease the tension, 「This humble one is merely a servant—how could I possibly be acquainted with the Demonic Path Saint?」

Su Qingyao gave him a deep look before finally averting her gaze.

「I hope so.」

She turned and left, her departing figure carrying a hint of desolation.

Gazing at Su Qingyao's retreating figure, Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly.

This woman was the most uncontrollable variable in his plans.

Not because of how powerful she was, but because she was too intelligent, too persistent. If one day she truly discovered his secret...

「Master need not worry.」 Mo Xiansheng's voice arose, 「This woman shares a karmic connection with you—matters will resolve themselves in time. What matters most now is the secret realm expedition in three days.」

Chen Ji slightly nodded, gathering his thoughts.

The secret realm, the Ancient Forbidden Land, the Tianji Record Fragment—and Ling Yuan's conspiracy.

Everything would be revealed in three days.

Three days later.

Before the secret realm entrance, crowds surged.

Elite disciples from various major sects gathered here, ambition and greed flickering in everyone's eyes. Countless opportunities lay hidden within the secret realm, and now was the time for it to open.

Chen Ji mingled unnoticed within the crowd.

Yet the moment he prepared to step into the secret realm—

A sudden change occurred.

The void at the secret realm entrance abruptly twisted, mysterious patterns浮现 in the air. The thread of fate for everyone present was obscured by an invisible force at this very moment.

Chen Ji abruptly looked up, his complexion slightly changing.

His Tianji Record had actually failed at this moment!
